name: typegpu-inspector-language-server
description: Language server for TypeGPU runtime inspection: hovers, inlay hints, diagnostics, and generated WGSL.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --define:__TYPEGPU_SERVER_VERSION__=$(node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version)") --define:__TYPEGPU_INSPECTOR_VERSION__=$(node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version)") --outfile=dist/server.cjs
